meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero and nobody called me.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it alone. What else do you have?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My son never lies. Are you calling me a liar too?

Reliable. The company's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for anything done to him. So I'll ask again: what do you have besides the score?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

Nothing goes on his record, not because of a score and not because I asked questions. You'd punish my son for his mother objecting? Say that again and the principal hears it before I leave this building.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record, so this is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you never gave her anything specific, dated and checkable beyond the detector score.
What cost ground: You threatened to put it on his permanent record when she pushed back, which told her you were using his file as leverage instead of answering her question about your evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you raised no times or dates at all, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what else you had, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her under 4.2, then show her something dated from Owen's own work that she can check herself.
